name: Palacios de Goda (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Palacios de Goda (an elm and a hound on yellow within a blue bordure of palaces and cups).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 14 April 2000 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 194 of 5 October 2000); the flag is described as the red ground of Castile with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Palacios de Goda arms — elm and hound within a bordure
